title: Maximum odd Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its odd Fourier maximum is the largest Fourier coefficient, in the real-valued sign representation of $f$, among the frequencies indexed by subsets of odd cardinality.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs
